title: [The Resonant Hull, Chamber]
description: Sliding paper-paneled screens line three faces of the chamber, their pale latticed surfaces diffusing light evenly across the interior.  The rear wall stands in contrast, solid cypress planking running floor-to-ceiling in continuous grain, supporting the racks and stands arranged before it and along the side walls, while two woven mats sit toward the center, flanking a low cypress table.  Providing accenting hues, vermilion trim follows the base of each wall and the screen rails above.
